targets.name: Export · HTML (modal) — the scope line is proposed; the shipping modal never says which page HTML writes as index.html, and the ZIP chip silently switches to every page (UX-E-14: ExportModal.tsx:97-100, ExportEngine.ts:216, :1090-1102). Both download handlers catch to a dev-only console log, so a failed export returns from its spinner as if it worked (UX-E-13: ExportModal.tsx:135, :156). Options › CMS bindings never renders — OptionsPanel is called without hasCMSBindings (:264), so the one option that changes what the content SAYS is dead (UX-E-16)
